dismissal.title: Dismissed
dismissal.body: The King relieves you of command. The roster takes the field under his orders; you remain to watch.

suspension.title: Suspended
suspension.body: You remain suspended after dismissal. The King commands until reinstatement is earned.

reinstatement.offer.title: Reinstatement offered
reinstatement.offer.body: The King offers reinstatement. Trust has recovered enough to compare your command against his.

reinstatement.accepted.title: Reinstated
reinstatement.accepted.body: You return to command under a King who has seen the alternative. The roster holds a comparison now — use it.

careerEnd.title: Career over
careerEnd.body: No King will start a match with you. The record stands: three courts heard you, and none will seat you again.

retirement.title: Retirement
retirement.body: {name} has carried enough. The {role} leaves service for good — a career ended by what the campaign asked of it.

grace.title: Grace
grace.body: Relief finds {name} unearned. Some of the {role}'s burden lifts — not because you gave it, and not to your credit.

freeAgentDecline.title: Declined
freeAgentDecline.body: {name} will not sign with you. Free agents read the same record the roster does.

successionCoda.title: Succession coda
successionCoda.body: Dismissed. The King commands the remainder — you spectate with no authority.

rout.title: Rout
rout.body: Your army has collapsed. Only the King remains — the match cannot continue as fought.

quietQuit.title: Quiet compliance
quietQuit.body: The order went through — the army did not. The piece complied while withholding effort.

firstRefusal.explainer.title: Why orders are refused
firstRefusal.explainer.body: Pieces reason from a limited view rather than the true score. The shortfall is sight, not disloyalty.

certificate.citation.title: Certificate of completion
certificate.citation.body: This certifies that career {careerId} concluded under seed {seed} with a replay-verifiable record. The board remembers everything.

audit.empty.title: Quiet ledger
audit.empty.body: Nothing worth testifying happened this match — which is itself a finding.
